),
materials_with_widths AS (
  SELECT 
    wwt.WallTypeName,
    m.Name as MaterialName,
    p.Name as ParameterName,
    p.Value as LayerThickness

  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON wwt.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex AND m.Category = 'IFCMATERIAL'
  LEFT JOIN ParameterText p ON wwt.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
  WHERE p.ParameterGroup = 'Qto_WallBaseQuantities'
    AND p.Name LIKE CONCAT(m.Name, '%/Width')
),
unique_materials_widths AS (

    MaterialName,

)

    wt.Name as WallTypeName,

  LEFT JOIN EntityText wt ON r.EntityIndexB = wt.EntityIndex AND wt.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'

  pt_area.Value AS Area,
  pt_thickness.Value AS Thickness

LEFT JOIN ParameterText pt_thickness ON roof.EntityIndex = pt_thickness.EntityIndex AND pt_thickness.Name = 'Thickness' AND pt_thickness.ParameterGroup = 'Dimensions'

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN roof.Name LIKE 'Basic Roof:Flachdachaufbau%' THEN 'Flachdachaufbau begrünt 320'
    WHEN roof.Name LIKE 'Basic Roof:Ziegeldach%' THEN 'Ziegeldach 360'
  END AS RoofType,
  COUNT(DISTINCT roof.StepId) AS NumberOfInstances,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(pt_area.Value, '0') AS FLOAT)) AS TotalArea,
  MAX(CAST(COALESCE(pt_thickness.Value, '0') AS FLOAT)) AS Thickness
FROM EntityText roof
LEFT JOIN ParameterText pt_area ON roof.EntityIndex = pt_area.EntityIndex AND pt_area.Name = 'Area' AND pt_area.ParameterGroup = 'Dimensions'
LEFT JOIN ParameterText pt_thickness ON roof.EntityIndex = pt_thickness.EntityIndex AND pt_thickness.Name = 'Thickness' AND pt_thickness.ParameterGroup = 'Dimensions'
